votes.motion: Adopt Joint Resolution 23 of 2021, declaring racism a public health crisis.
votes.description: A joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall formally declaring racism a public health crisis in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and refer Item B-1 (2020 Emergency Management Performance Grant) to a future Consent Agenda for action.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a grant application from Emergency Management to the Utah Division of Emergency Management for emergency preparedness planning and public education, and refers it for future consent agenda action.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 38 of 2022, amending the FY 2021-22 final budget of Salt Lake City including the employment staffing document (Budget Amendment No. 1).
votes.description: Amends the FY2021-22 budget to include police department salary changes, non-represented employee salary changes, emergency rental assistance funding, and police salary changes funded by ARPA dollars.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and refer item back to the Mosquito Abatement District for their budget process.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the Mosquito Abatement District's intent to levy a property tax increase for FY2022 and refers the matter back to the District.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 37 of 2021, to amend the zoning map for properties located at approximately 860 and 868 East 3rd Avenue.
votes.description: Rezones parcels at 860 and 868 East 3rd Avenue from CN and SR-1A to R-MU-35 to allow for potential multi-family development within the Avenues Local Historic District.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 39 of 2021, to amend zoning of properties at approximately 850 and 870 East 2100 South.
votes.description: Rezones properties from CC to CSHBD2 and amends the Sugar House Master Plan Future Land Use Map to allow more flexibility for multi-family, office, or mixed-use development.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 40 of 2021, to amend the zoning map for a parcel of property at approximately 810 East 800 South.
votes.description: Rezones the parcel from R-2 to CB and amends the Central Community Future Land Use Map to allow a two-story commercial and residential mixed-use development.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 25 of 2021, intention to designate Central Business Improvement Area 2022.
votes.description: Adopts a resolution of intention to re-establish the Central Business Improvement Area 2022, enabling a special assessment on commercial property in downtown for marketing, promotion, and related programs for a three-year period.

votes.motion: Suspend the rules and adopt Resolution 24 of 2021, authorizing the interlocal agreement between Salt Lake City, the Redevelopment Agency (RDA), and the Utah Performing Arts Center Agency (URACA), for operation of the George S. and Delores Dore Eccles Theater.
votes.description: Ratifies a second amendment to an interlocal agreement among Salt Lake City, the RDA, and UPACA governing the operation of the Eccles Theater.

votes.motion: Suspend the rules and adopt Ordinance 36 of 2021, amending sections of the Salt Lake City code relating to campaign finance reporting and personal campaign committees.
votes.description: Amends city code to add a new campaign finance report requirement for the Ranked Choice Voting pilot program and aligns other campaign finance provisions with current State Code.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 41 of 2021, amending section 8.04.390 of Salt Lake City Code relating to animals running at large and other parks.
votes.description: Amends city code to include Allen Park in the list of City parks and to prohibit dogs at Allen Park to protect wildlife, site amenities, and public safety, with an exemption for service dogs.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 42 of 2021, approving the Memorandum of Understanding between Salt Lake City and International Association of Firefighters Local 81, representing eligible employees, pursuant to the Collective Bargaining and Employee Representation Joint Resolutions.
votes.description: Approves the FY2021-22 MOU between Salt Lake City and the International Association of Firefighters Local 81 governing wages and working conditions for eligible firefighter employees.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 44 of 2021, approving a Memorandum of Understanding between Salt Lake City and Salt Lake Police Association, representing the eligible employees, pursuant to the Collective Bargaining and Employee Representation Joint Resolution.
votes.description: Approves the FY2021-22 MOU between Salt Lake City and the Salt Lake City Police Association governing wages and working conditions for eligible police employees.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 43 of 2021, appropriating necessary funds to implement, for FY 21-22, the provisions of a Memorandum of Understanding between Salt Lake City Corporation and the American Federation of State, County and Municipal Employees (AFSCME) Local 1004.
votes.description: Appropriates the funds needed to implement the FY2021-22 AFSCME Local 1004 MOU covering wages and working conditions for eligible city employees.

Approves multiple consent agenda items including setting public hearing dates for ordinances on administrative decision appeals, special exception process elimination, the Encircle rezone, Rosewood Park street and alley vacation, and the Central Business Improvement Area 2022 public hearing date.
